title: The question, handed back as buttons
blurb: A run that will not choose between two companies sharing a name now hands the choice back — one button per company, each carrying a whole prompt, so answering costs one click rather than a retyped idea. The gate had already resolved them: a name read off each company’s own front page, a canonical domain, and the line that tells them apart. What was missing was somewhere to put them, because the operator’s reason field is never shown verbatim and these are shown verbatim.
